content: TabAPI v1 has NO dedicated 'referring sites by traffic' endpoint. Referral capability = Backlinks API (GET /domains/{domain}/backlinks, 5 credits): overview (domain_rating 0-100, backlinks count, referring_domains count, dofollow pct for backlinks and referring domains) plus a SAMPLE of top backlinks (from_url, to_url, title, anchor, domain_rating). No per-referring-domain traffic share, no first-seen dates. Traffic API's traffic_sources.referrals + paid_referrals channel shares give aggregate referral context. SimilarWeb-style Incoming-Traffic table (per-referrer traffic share, MoM change, engagement) is NOT achievable from TabAPI alone.
